ANIL MASCARENHAS

Product Owner | Fintech | AI-Powered Products | Employee Benefits|US Healthcare|

mascarenhasanil91@gmail.com | +91 9741956017 | Bangalore linkedin.com/in/anil-mascarenhas-607121217/

SUMMARY

Product Owner with 5.1 years of product experience and 10 years of experience in US Healthcare industry, delivering fintech and AI-powered products across employee benefits, claims, mobile, and data platforms. Deeply curious about the customer friction hidden in benefits journeys: helping members access their benefits is only the first step; helping them understand eligibility, complete claims, and return with confidence is where the real product value is created. Proven ability to turn ambiguous, conflicting inputs into clear product roadmaps, ship iteratively across small, medium, and large releases, and use behavioural data to continuously improve customer experience. Comfortable working across engineering, analytics, design, AI, and business teams at pace.

KEY PRODUCT IMPACT

Identified a potential business opportunity related to approximately $25.6M in ineligible benefit transactions, with projected savings potential of $1.28M to $5.12M based on reducing ineligible transactions by 5% to 20%. The solution was validated by leadership, added to the product roadmap, and received the Best Innovation Award while competing against more than 30 teams at the 2025 hackathon.

Achieved a 40% reduction in processing turnaround time via LLM-based decisioning.

Delivered a 10-20% reduction in support ticket volume following a full-scale overhaul of a platform serving

1.5M+ monthly active users.

Achieved 90% sprint-goal completion through disciplined backlog management and clear story authoring.

Achieved HIPAA and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across a large-scale fintech platform.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Product Owner | Alegeus Technologies	2024 - Present

Own continuous product improvement across a fintech and employee-benefits platform, prioritizing a portfolio of small, medium, and large releases across Claims AI, mobile, CIP/HSA Document Management, employer platforms, and data products.

Worked with healthcare and benefits clients such as Anthem, Anglore,aligaht,, Highmark, IGOE, Fours, and Clarity.

Worked on US healthcare and employee benefits products, including claims and AI-based solutions, and worked with clients to understand their requirements and improve the product.

Shape Claims AI initiatives by translating complex claims, eligibility, and automation needs into scalable product experiences that improve processing accuracy, reduce manual effort, and simplify the experience for members and administrators.

Identified a potential business opportunity related to approximately $25.6M in ineligible benefit transactions, developed the product opportunity and value case, and supported leadership validation and roadmap placement.

Own product requirements across mobile capabilities including Mobile Wallet Push Provisioning, Bank Account Ownership Verification, IAM, authentication, account management, security, and card experiences.

Understand users through stakeholder discussions, client feedback, Pendo product analytics, Jobs-to-Be-Done analysis, and operational insights, translating behavioural findings into clear product improvements for products serving approximately 176K mobile monthly active users and 1.26M WCP users.

Drove product requirements for a full-scale overhaul of a customer-facing platform serving 1.5M+ monthly active users, contributing to a 10-20% reduction in support ticket volume after launch.

Turn incomplete, conflicting, and ambiguous inputs into clear sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria, enabling engineering teams to deliver against goals and contributing to 90% sprint-goal completion.

Define roadmap priorities by balancing customer problems, partner requirements, business goals, technical dependencies, compliance needs, production issues, and delivery capacity while collaborating with engineering, API, AI, QA, design, security, analytics, and business teams.

Support Data Platform initiatives spanning Data Explorer, custom report migration readiness, data reconciliation, Snowflake, ODS, OLTP, Sigma, Power BI, and API dependencies.

Senior Business Analyst | ATG Technologies	2021 - 2024

Supported product and business analysis for financial-services products, balancing customer needs, business goals, compliance requirements, and technical constraints across a multi-client environment.

Drove roadmap and backlog decisions by analysing user needs, operational pain points, product gaps, and business priorities, translating findings into prioritized product improvements.

Turned ambiguous stakeholder inputs and conflicting requirements into structured product plans, workflows, user stories, and acceptance criteria while maintaining alignment across engineering, design, analytics, business, and external teams.

Collaborated with delivery and compliance teams to ship scalable product solutions that reduced customer friction and improved the overall experience.

Subject Matter Expert | Hinduja Global Solutions - Humana	2016 - 2021

Served as a Subject Matter Expert for Humana's Special Investigation Unit, analyzing complex health insurance cases and supporting accurate and compliant resolution.

Identified process gaps, clarified business rules, and collaborated with operational teams to improve workflow consistency and case handling.

Created process guidance and supported team training by translating complex insurance requirements into clear, actionable instructions.

INNOVATION AND HACKATHON PROJECTS

AI-Powered Benefits Eligibility and Smart Payment Experience | Alegeus Hackathon 2025

Co-developed an AI-powered solution that identifies eligibility across HSA, FSA, and LSA plans, routes expenses to the correct benefit account, and supports seamless payment splitting.

Addressed approximately $25.6M in potentially ineligible benefit transactions that could lead to denied claims, payment friction, manual processing, and member dissatisfaction.

Developed the business-value case, with projected savings potential of $1.28M to $5.12M based on reducing ineligible transactions by 5% to 20%.

Validated the solution with leadership, supported its addition to the product roadmap, and received the Best Innovation Award while competing against more than 30 teams.

SKILLS

Product Ownership: Backlog Management | Sprint Planning | Agile Scrum | SAFe | PI Planning | User Story and Acceptance Criteria Authoring | Product Roadmapping and Prioritization | Product Discovery | Jobs-to-Be-Done Domain: Fintech Product Management | Employee Benefits (HSA/FSA/HRA/CIP) | Claims AI | Mobile Product Management | AI-Powered Personalization

AI / Data: Generative AI | LLM-Based Decisioning | AI for Product Management | SQL | Python | Pendo Product Analytics

| Snowflake | Power BI | Sigma

Tools: Jira | Confluence | Aha! | Azure DevOps | Azure OpenAI | Figma

Delivery: HIPAA Compliance | WCAG 2.2 AA Compliance | B2B SaaS | Stakeholder Management | Cross-Functional Collaboration | API Requirements and Integration | Data Product Requirements | ODS | OLTP

CERTIFICATIONS

Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) | Scrum.org | 08/2025

AI for Product Management | Pendo in collaboration with Google Cloud | 07/2026

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (Business Management) | CGPA: 7.4 SDM Autonomous College, Mangalore | 2013 - 2016

SUMMARY
Product Owner with 5.1 years of product experience and 10 years of experience in US Healthcare industry, delivering fintech and AI-powered products across employee benefits, claims, mobile, and data platforms. Deeply curious about the customer friction hidden in benefits journeys: helping members access their benefits is only the first step; helping them understand eligibility, complete claims, and return with confidence is where the real product value is created. Proven ability to turn ambiguous, conflicting inputs into clear product roadmaps, ship iteratively across small, medium, and large releases, and use behavioural data to continuously improve customer experience. Comfortable working across engineering, analytics, design, AI, and business teams at pace.
KEY PRODUCT IMPACT
Identified a potential business opportunity related to approximately $25.6M in ineligible benefit transactions, with projected savings potential of $1.28M to $5.12M based on reducing ineligible transactions by 5% to 20%. The solution was validated by leadership, added to the product roadmap, and received the Best Innovation Award while competing against more than 30 teams at the 2025 hackathon.
Achieved a 40% reduction in processing turnaround time via LLM-based decisioning.
Delivered a 10-20% reduction in support ticket volume following a full-scale overhaul of a platform serving
1.5M+ monthly active users.
Achieved 90% sprint-goal completion through disciplined backlog management and clear story authoring.
Achieved HIPAA and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across a large-scale fintech platform.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Product Owner | Alegeus Technologies	2024 - Present
Own continuous product improvement across a fintech and employee-benefits platform, prioritizing a portfolio of small, medium, and large releases across Claims AI, mobile, CIP/HSA Document Management, employer platforms, and data products.
Worked with healthcare and benefits clients such as Anthem, Anglore,aligaht,, Highmark, IGOE, Fours, and Clarity.
Worked on US healthcare and employee benefits products, including claims and AI-based solutions, and worked with clients to understand their requirements and improve the product.
Shape Claims AI initiatives by translating complex claims, eligibility, and automation needs into scalable product experiences that improve processing accuracy, reduce manual effort, and simplify the experience for members and administrators.
Identified a potential business opportunity related to approximately $25.6M in ineligible benefit transactions, developed the product opportunity and value case, and supported leadership validation and roadmap placement.
Own product requirements across mobile capabilities including Mobile Wallet Push Provisioning, Bank Account Ownership Verification, IAM, authentication, account management, security, and card experiences.
Understand users through stakeholder discussions, client feedback, Pendo product analytics, Jobs-to-Be-Done analysis, and operational insights, translating behavioural findings into clear product improvements for products serving approximately 176K mobile monthly active users and 1.26M WCP users.
Drove product requirements for a full-scale overhaul of a customer-facing platform serving 1.5M+ monthly active users, contributing to a 10-20% reduction in support ticket volume after launch.
Turn incomplete, conflicting, and ambiguous inputs into clear sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria, enabling engineering teams to deliver against goals and contributing to 90% sprint-goal completion.
Define roadmap priorities by balancing customer problems, partner requirements, business goals, technical dependencies, compliance needs, production issues, and delivery capacity while collaborating with engineering, API, AI, QA, design, security, analytics, and business teams.
Support Data Platform initiatives spanning Data Explorer, custom report migration readiness, data reconciliation, Snowflake, ODS, OLTP, Sigma, Power BI, and API dependencies.
Senior Business Analyst | ATG Technologies	2021 - 2024
Supported product and business analysis for financial-services products, balancing customer needs, business goals, compliance requirements, and technical constraints across a multi-client environment.
Drove roadmap and backlog decisions by analysing user needs, operational pain points, product gaps, and business priorities, translating findings into prioritized product improvements.
Turned ambiguous stakeholder inputs and conflicting requirements into structured product plans, workflows, user stories, and acceptance criteria while maintaining alignment across engineering, design, analytics, business, and external teams.
Collaborated with delivery and compliance teams to ship scalable product solutions that reduced customer friction and improved the overall experience.
Subject Matter Expert | Hinduja Global Solutions - Humana	2016 - 2021
Served as a Subject Matter Expert for Humana's Special Investigation Unit, analyzing complex health insurance cases and supporting accurate and compliant resolution.
Identified process gaps, clarified business rules, and collaborated with operational teams to improve workflow consistency and case handling.
Created process guidance and supported team training by translating complex insurance requirements into clear, actionable instructions.
INNOVATION AND HACKATHON PROJECTS
AI-Powered Benefits Eligibility and Smart Payment Experience | Alegeus Hackathon 2025
Co-developed an AI-powered solution that identifies eligibility across HSA, FSA, and LSA plans, routes expenses to the correct benefit account, and supports seamless payment splitting.
Addressed approximately $25.6M in potentially ineligible benefit transactions that could lead to denied claims, payment friction, manual processing, and member dissatisfaction.
Developed the business-value case, with projected savings potential of $1.28M to $5.12M based on reducing ineligible transactions by 5% to 20%.
Validated the solution with leadership, supported its addition to the product roadmap, and received the Best Innovation Award while competing against more than 30 teams.
